title: A new text model for Roblox roleplay
summary:
A new roleplay text model, a community Telegram bot, and better accounting for text requests.

Added `roblox-rp` with anonymous access and tool support. Requests randomly route to Llama 3 8B Instruct or Mistral Small 2402 on Bedrock. The same work extracted message sanitization into a shared utility and removed `claudyclaude` from the available model list.

Added Pollix AI, a multilingual Telegram assistant with fast replies and image understanding, to the project list and social bots catalog.

Reworked text-request events to record timing, status, model selection, token usage, and moderation results. The model list also dropped `gpt-5-nano`, while `openai-large` access changed from seed to flower.

highlights.title: Roblox roleplay text model
highlights.text: Try `roblox-rp` for roleplay text with tool support and anonymous access. Requests route to either Llama 3 8B Instruct or Mistral Small 2402. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=roblox-rp).
